title: Segmented Traffic Composer with Quarantine & Explainable Rollback
creator: Aisha Rana
description:
Problem: Existing rollout composer focuses on flat traffic splits and manual rollback triggers. Customers running segmented experiments (by tenant, region, or device class) need an authoring surface that makes it easy to target cohorts, quarantine failing segments automatically, and explain why a rollback happened.

Proposed solution: A Segmented Traffic Composer that combines a visual segment selector, per-segment traffic curves, and a quarantine lane where variants can be automatically isolated when health signals cross thresholds. The composer integrates an explainable-rollback panel that surfaces request-level examples, statistical deltas, and estimated cost delta for rollback vs continue. Deliverables: interactive Figma prototype, acceptance criteria for engineering handoff, and a small moderated usability study with infra/platform PMs and two customer beta teams.
design_goals: Make segment-based splits first-class (tenant, region, device, custom attributes)
Provide an automated quarantine path that isolates a failing variant for affected segments while preserving global traffic
Expose explainability artefacts (sample diffs, response quality metrics) next to rollback controls
Surface cost and latency trade-offs inline as users compose traffic curves
Enable easy conversion from shadow traffic to canary and back
decisions: Quarantine will be implemented as a transient routing override that holds 0% for the affected segment but maintains metrics visibility
Explainable rollback will include three layers: sampled request diffs, short-term regression score, and token-level latency histogram
Default quarantine policy: 75th-percentile latency increase > 50% OR error-rate uplift > 3x for 5 minutes triggers suggestion
We decoupled cost estimator from exact token-counts — it will show delta ranges (low/median/high) to avoid implying false precision

acceptance_criteria: Designer handoff includes annotated Figma screens and interaction spec
ENG implements a quarantine routing override pattern and exposes events for UI to surface
Explainable rollback panel shows sample requests, regression score, and token-latency histogram for the selected time window
Composer allows authors to target segments by up to 3 attributes and preview routing outcomes in sandbox
Cost delta ribbon displayed and matches engineering microbenchmarks within acceptable range (median +/-10%)
Moderated usability test with at least 6 participants yields SUS >= 75 or specific action items addressed
